[P1] Check the effective Athena result location

An Athena workgroup with `EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration` enabled overrides the submitted output location even when `athenaOutputLocation` is nonempty. If the configured location is outside the data prefix but the enforced location is inside a scanned partition, this check returns `read-only` and bypasses consent while queries write into the table's data. Resolve the effective location, including workgroup enforcement, before classifying it; return `unknown` when that location cannot be established.
